Michelle has been working in Dahanu for many years and her school - Tamarind Tree provides a holistic education to hundreds of tribal children from the surrounding areas. Her use of technology to unshackle education and content and overcome problems of unavailability, inadequacy and inaccessibility have been pioneering. Michelle has been an ardent supporter of Pratham Books long since before we went digital. She has recently started a small bookstore on her school campus so that children and parents can buy books. Cheers Michelle and more strength to you.
